project.name: TouchScene
project.one_sentence: Speech explains what is present, planar touch communicates where it is, and sparse haptics guide independent framing.

product_model.planar_touch_role: active exploration of position, boundary, extent, and empty space
product_model.exploration_map_policy: freeze during touch exploration; mark stale on material camera movement and refresh explicitly

binary_semantics.1: selected subject and sustained or low-duty repeating feedback
binary_semantics.edge: separate thick boundary map with a discrete entry or crossing pulse

product_model.critical_boundary: A single phone or tablet motor provides global vibration; spatial layout comes from touch coordinates and proprioception, not localized actuation.

camera_sdk.ble_role: control and Wi-Fi bootstrap; no preview stream
camera_sdk.recommended_app_boundary: Android native or native plus WebView; keep PWA as fallback
camera_sdk.access_dependency: SDK download and Maven credentials from Insta360 developer application
